parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotation blade of the knife, made of stainless steel, typically sharp and durable.
parts.Functional_description: It performs the cutting function of the knife and can rotate or fold into the base body for safety.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a pivot point to open or close, allowing the knife to switch between usable and stored states.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or handle of the knife, made of aluminum alloy for lightweight strength.
parts.Functional_description: It provides grip and houses the rotation mechanism for the blade, ensuring safe handling and control.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while providing a stable base for the rotating blade.
